<!-- Source page: Plotinus -->

[Plotinus](https://github.com/p-e-w/plotinus) is a searchable command palette in every modern GTK application.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-program-plotinus).
